header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Farhan Ahmed Bozdar, advocate for the petitioner
Mr. Badal Gahoti, advocate for the respondent No.8
Mr. Muhammad Shareef Solangi, A.A.G a/w Khan Muhammad,
body: XEN Mithrao Sub-Division, Mirpurkhas = Through this petition, the petitioner is seeking directions to be issued to the respondents to remove/dismantle the illegally installed 04 inches pipe by the respondent No.8. XEN Mithrao Sub-Division Mirpurkhas is present and submits that 04 inches pipe is installed. Under these circumstances, this petition is disposed of with directions to Executive Engineer to remove the illegally installed pipe within one week. However, they are also directed to provide water to the respondent No.8 in accordance with the law.
